title: When the step is skipped
idea: Tracing what happens when the condition is False - the guarded step is skipped and the program continues below. Careful tracing.

exercises.prompt:
What does this print?

x = 3
if x > 10:
    print("big")
print("done")
exercises.explanation: 3 > 10 is False, so 'big' is skipped. 'done' is not indented, so it still prints.

exercises.prompt:
What does this print?

x = 30
if x > 10:
    print("big")
print("done")
exercises.explanation: 30 > 10 is True, so 'big' prints. Then 'done' always prints. Both appear.

exercises.prompt: When the condition is False, the program simply continues after the guarded step.
exercises.explanation: Yes - a skipped if just means the guarded lines don't run; the rest of the program carries on.

exercises.prompt:
How many lines print?

score = 40
if score >= 50:
    print("Pass")
    print("Well done")
exercises.explanation: 40 >= 50 is False, so BOTH guarded lines are skipped. Nothing prints.

exercises.prompt:
How many lines print?

score = 90
if score >= 50:
    print("Pass")
    print("Well done")
exercises.explanation: 90 >= 50 is True, so both guarded lines run. Two lines print.

exercises.prompt:
What prints?

open_now = False
if open_now:
    print("Enter")
print("Thanks")
exercises.explanation: open_now is False, so 'Enter' is skipped. 'Thanks' is unindented and always runs.

exercises.prompt:
What prints?

n = 5
if n == 5:
    print("five")
print("end")
exercises.explanation: 5 == 5 is True, so 'five' prints, then the always-on 'end' prints too.

exercises.prompt:
This should print nothing. Fill a value for temp that makes the condition False:

temp = ____
if temp > 100:
    print("Boiling")
exercises.explanation: Any value not greater than 100 (like 50) makes temp > 100 False, so the guarded step is skipped.

exercises.prompt: An unindented line after the if runs whether the condition was True or False.
exercises.explanation: Yes - only the indented lines are guarded. Unindented lines always run.

exercises.prompt: Why practice tracing the False case?
options: To be sure the right lines are skipped and the rest still runs
exercises.explanation: Half the value of an if is what it DOESN'T do. Tracing the skip keeps your mental model correct.
